eras.label: current
eras.source: Delaware General Assembly (SB 199, finalized by HB 335)
eras.note: HB 335 made administrative line adjustments requested by the Dept. of Elections, not a substantive redraw. Unchallenged in court. Delaware uses a 3/5 veto-override threshold, not the more common 2/3.

redistricting.text: Kept 86% of its population from the 2016–2020 HD-1; gained the rest from the old HD-4 (14%). Entirely in New Castle County. 2020 presidential margin D+81.3 on the 2016–2020 lines → D+80.2 on the current lines.

Kept 88% of its population from the 2016–2020 HD-2; gained the rest from the old HD-4 (5%), the old HD-1 (4%), the old HD-13 (3%). Entirely in New Castle County. 2020 presidential margin D+80.8 on the 2016–2020 lines → D+77.5 on the current lines.
